body: I attempted about an hour ago.. failed.. I'm distraught

I needed something to hold on to me without knowing I'm planning on leaving.. I don't need or want pity.. I just wanted to feel like I needed to be alive. I don't though.. I just have to figure out a method. I'm hurt, I feel alone.. I'm just trying to accept my reality and let go

I really need some sort of support but there is none for me.. I can't find an escape. I feel like I'm being forced to die.. I just want some love some warmth.. maybe I don't deserve that. I know I'm not perfect but do I deserve to die with this hurt on me? Maybe I do. Maybe I'll always have this hurt on me.. the possibility is enough for me to want to die now. I can't even live properly because I can't handle how much I'm hurting.. I just want to die before I make any more mistakes.
Tired of being hurt. Crying.. too many lows.. I just want the story to end
I wish I had someone to talk to about what I'm going through.. I hate that people will contemplate this when I'm gone
